messages:
elisabeth: Datadog partner PM asked for a single launch bundle for the marketplace tile: minimal OTLP snippet, three screenshotable dashboard panels, a short privacy checklist, and a smoke-test runbook. Can we compile this by EOW?

noah: Eng: yes. We'll provide a tiny OTLP example, sampling guidance, and an exporter sanitizer. Key requirements: per-tenant API key (KMS), site selection, and strip request bodies + emails.

darya: Security: prefer HMAC-keyed hashing for user identifiers, not plain hashes. Enforce per-tenant keys in KMS and mTLS to Datadog endpoints. Also include audit-log retention guidance (365 days) for export actions.

harry: Legal: will prepare the public checklist. Must include: "No PII in screenshots", link to DPA summary, and a note that this is operational guidance (not contractual). For GovCloud, confirm routing to GovCloud endpoints only.

tia: Marketing: want three panels: latency p50/p95, tokens/sec, fallback %. Also a 1-paragraph tile blurb and three localized screenshots (US/EU/GovCloud). Prefer 48-hour partner review window.

datadog-integ-bot: request: upload sanitized dashboard JSON and OTLP snippet to run quick ingest smoke test.

noah: OTLP snippet we can show (YAML):
```yaml
receivers:
  otlp:
    protocols:
      grpc: {}
processors:
  sanitize:
    rules:
      - key: user.email
        action: remove
      - key: request.body
        action: remove
  hash_user_id:
    key: ${HMAC_KEY}  # use keyed HMAC
  batch: {}
exporters:
  datadog:
    api_key: ${DD_API_KEY}  # per-tenant, store in KMS
    site: datadoghq.com
service:
  pipelines:
    traces:
      receivers: [otlp]
      processors: [sanitize, hash_user_id, batch]
      exporters: [datadog]
```

darya: I'll add a short note about re-identification risks even with hashing and recommend periodic key rotation.

harry: checklist bullets to include in the public bundle: ["Confirm data residency per-customer","No customer-identifiable data in screenshots","Link to DPA summary","Audit logs for exports retained 365 days","Operational guidance only - not a contract"].

tia: dashboard JSON (anonymized quick example): {"widgets":[{"title":"latency p50/p95","metric":"redwood.request.latency_p95"},{"title":"tokens/sec","metric":"redwood.token.count"},{"title":"fallback %","metric":"redwood.model.fallback_rate"}]}

noah: created branch partners/datadog-launch-compact and pushed exporter sanitizer + small smoke fixture.

datadog-integ-bot: smoke-test queued for partner=redwood, env=staging.

datadog-integ-bot: smoke-test result: ingestion OK (2026-03-25T11:22:10Z) - 300 traces accepted, dashboard render OK.

elisabeth: thanks team. Owners/ETA: 1) Noah - final OTLP snippet + PR link (Tue). 2) Darya - security note + KMS rotation guidance (Wed). 3) Harry - public checklist + DPA link (Wed). 4) Tia - screenshots + tile blurb (Thu). We'll send package to datadog-partners@ after legal sign-off. :thumbsup:
